remarks: Come see this wonderful apartment in The Iconic Biltmore Luxury Condominium Complex. Unit has recently Been fully renovated throughout with spacious rooms, excellent kitchen and bath, Fixtures and Appliances. Convenient in town location, and Amazing 15th floor views. Enjoy a building with a 24-hour concierge, shuttle service to the train, state-of-the-art fitness center, a community room, a courtyard, and pet-friendly amenities. Additional features include storage options and garage parking for 2 cars ($110/mo per car). The prime location provides easy access to highways, Metro North, restaurants, shopping, etc. Walk to entertainment options and everything that Stamford Downtown has available as well as Bedford Street area.
